name: export_holdings_20261103
comment: 2026-11-03 (operator Step 1, SPEC_POSITIONS_DB_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH): holdings_export renders holdings.json FROM positions_current on every sync, atomically and mode 600, and never reads the existing file as input. Tests pin the accepted cases: 0-byte and corrupt stores regenerate without being read, a DB failure or zero rows refuses and leaves the last good file, retention keeps 48 hourly + 30 daily under a size cap, and the P1 fires only for an empty export, a stale one in market hours, or a totals delta over one dollar.
